verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order TRAVEL MAKEUP KIT, but the KIT plate has come loose. The word sits bare on the photo, right against the MAKEUP bar, and an empty white bar floats at the bottom right. The TRAVEL and MAKEUP bars run together into one lopsided strip. B gets the headline order wrong (MAKEUP TRAVEL KIT), and its KIT plate is jammed against the top edge, with the oversized KIT glyphs nearly cut off. That breaks the hierarchy, the order and the fit, so A is the less bad of the two.
